rules: Analysis JSON must be same-origin static data paths.
External or traversal paths are rejected before fetch.
Large JSON payloads are rejected before activation.
Bundle loading uses bounded concurrency rather than unbounded Promise.all.
Cached datasets are namespaced by the current runtime data fingerprint.
The runtime data version manifest is fetched without the browser cache.
A top-level load must observe the same fingerprint before and after loading or restart.
A changed fingerprint clears the in-memory dataset cache before new data is activated.
